mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and both drugs can increase depression/suicidal ideation risk; citalopram may increase isotretinoin levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and both share hepatic metabolism pathways.
action: Monitor closely for psychiatric symptoms and suicidal ideation; ensure effective contraception if female of childbearing potential; consider baseline and periodic LFTs; citalopram dosing may require adjustment.
